notes.title: Online Competitive, Well, Online
notes.notes:
We have put up 1v1 and 2v2 modes


Please be noted that Online Function was not originally intended for the game which was offline only. However, we just happened to figure it out with many helps from fellow devs. So we just added it here as extra bonus for the game. And we are still working on it. 

Be advised: This is a P2P system. You will experience lags if connected with people from far away. It's always best to invite friends who live close by your area or city.

Thanks and Enjoy :)

Please be sure to join our Steam Group for future contents and giveaways

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/digorg#

Also check out our new weapon update
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27050087/1a1fdc691b41c03dcd67b15fc7b8abfdaa3b24f6.jpg[/img]

MG42 (Mustard Paint): A tool of Nightmare. The alien will learn that Humanity is also capable of terrible destructions. 200 rounds of pain can be released in matter of minutes. Nothing feels better than being a hero with a big gun standing on a pile of alien dead bodies.

AA12 (Ketchup Paint): Do you feel that you are always fully stacked with shotgun ammo? Well, Your pocket will be drained down fast with Ketchup. Packed with 32 devastating rounds of shotgun shells, Ketchup brings the total annihilation to anyone who dares standing against it. The alien will think twice before messing with humanity again. 

Cross Bow (Ranch Paint): Don't you wish your grenades to fly straight at your enemies? Ranch will deliver just that idea directly to their faces. Each arrow is equipped with a deadly explosive device that will blast everything on impact. Ranch only hopes you don't mind the mess. 

Location: 
Spy: Take down any Spy from either mission to get AA12
Kill Drone-Robot (Valley/Farms) MG42 
Kill Mole (Forest) Cross Bow

Arena: Horde: You can test your three new weapons or any weapon here once you acquire them

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0
notes.notes:
Bugs:

_Fixed key binding not saved after reset missions or game
_Fixed Screen-Shake setting

Arena:

_A new mission has been added (if you experience any bug, please report in bug reports forum)

Balancing:

_Prison player now has 300 health
_WWII player now has 400 health
_Player now can refill ammo and health before major boss fights
_Reduced health on some bosses


Screen-Shake:

_Reduced screen-shake
_Screen-shake can be turned off anytime during gameplay

Also, be sure to join our Steam Group :)

http://steamcommunity.com/groups/digorg
